finding: Android 14+ provides a public AccessibilityService SurfaceControl overlay path that directly matches Gen3 single-owner presentation: build FoldOverlayView in SurfaceControlViewHost, obtain SurfacePackage.getSurfaceControl(), then attachAccessibilityOverlayToDisplay(displayId, sc). Framework docs explicitly state the same overlay SurfaceControl is transferred when attached to a new display. Current Duo Open instead hosts snapshot glass through WindowManager accessibility-overlay windows and separately retains a Shizuku IWindowManager.mirrorDisplay/DisplayMirrorHost system, so ownership is more complex than necessary. SurfaceControl public transforms are affine/crop/scale; retain AGSL for glass perspective/refraction. API35 TransactionCompleted gives a presented callback/present fence for real presentation timing.
recommendation: Prototype a single direct accessibility SurfaceControl host before further expanding live-mirror/window machinery. Do not replace AGSL with compositor geometry. Field-test cover<->inner transfer latency, present callbacks, reversal fencing, relayout, and capture exclusion. If successful, delete privileged live-mirror runtime and six-strip LiveBlurSurface from Fold7 production path.
